latest.notes:
The log report now says what the music was fitted around.

If you see 'Music fitted around 48 breaks holding 1:36:00', the hours were built around the commercials actually in them and the generation worked.

If you see 'The music was fitted around 48 EMPTY breaks', the commercials arrived after the music was scheduled — so every hour was sized as if the station had none, and whatever lands in those breaks afterwards pushes the hour past its top. That is the fault, named outright, instead of something you can only infer from a day totalling more than 24 hours.
